column1: # the base weight of each legal-form group: P(group | country, section, band) is base x odds (form_odds.tsv), normalised. A country's own row for the section when it has one; else the pooled row (country *) times the country's multipliers (section *), the multipliers applying to micro and small firms only (medium and large firms take the pooled row for every group the country has); see doc/data.md
